RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from this information.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications are strong, but a head-of-function role may also prioritize leadership, regulatory judgment, and stakeholder management. The announcement may omit relevant experience.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and feedback on the decisive differences—not an explanation based on panel members’ sex.

If you uncover sex-related remarks, inconsistent criteria, or evidence of unequal treatment, raise those specifics. If you are considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
